title: Pipeline Today
description: A salesperson's morning view: drag deals between stages (or move them with the keyboard) while each column's weighted value and the forecast roll live, and a Focus rail tells you who to act on and why, with one-click email, call and snooze that update the deal.

title: Admin Users
description: A members admin with seat and 2FA stats, role and status filters, a sortable table you can bulk-edit, an invite dialog that checks emails as chips, and a drawer with each person's devices and activity.

title: Appearance Settings
description: Theme cards with miniature previews above a compact live app that re-themes with a circular wipe, eases into your accent colour and glides between densities as you change them.

title: Article Cards
description: A blog grid led by one large featured post, each card with drawn cover art, tags, reading time and author, lifting gently on hover while its cover drifts closer.

title: Assistant App
description: A small, complete assistant with chats and projects in the sidebar, files you can attach, and replies that write themselves out word by word.

title: Assistant Start
description: The first screen of an AI assistant, with chats and projects down the side, a gooey orb that says hello and a prompt box that gathers tools and connected apps as context, then glides down into the conversation when you send.

title: Before & After Hero
description: A hero split down the middle: drag the handle and a messy expense spreadsheet turns into a clean, matched ledger row by row, while the headline flips from a week to an afternoon.

title: Billing Overview
description: A billing page in one glance: plan and seats, the next invoice with its cycle progress, a payment card that holds its colours in both themes, usage bars that warn near the limit, and invoices with a one-click retry.

title: Blur Rise
description: Text that drifts up and comes into focus a letter or a word at a time as it scrolls into view, quick enough that nobody waits to read it.

title: Calendar Week
description: A week calendar you can push around: drag events to move or stretch them on a 15-minute snap, drag empty time to create one, nudge with the arrow keys, and watch the now line creep down the day.

title: Card Deal
description: A grid that deals itself out from one point like a hand of cards: each card flies to its slot tilted and settles flat, and a shuffle sweeps them back into the deck and deals a fresh order, even mid-flight.

title: Changelog
description: A release timeline with sticky version tags, New / Improved / Fixed chips you can filter by, small drawn media cards instead of screenshots, and a load-more that eases older releases into place.

title: Checkout
description: A one-page checkout that folds each finished step into a one-line summary: inline validation that clears as you type, delivery choices that re-total the order, a card that flips when you reach the CVC, and a calm confirmation.

title: Checkout Summary
description: A checkout with generic express-pay buttons, delivery options that slide a selection ring, quantity steppers, a promo field that validates, and totals whose digits roll as anything changes.

title: City Time
description: A local-time page for any city: a live clock whose digits roll, the sun on today's arc, your working hours against theirs with the best time to meet, and the year's clock changes, all re-computed as you switch cities.

title: Co-writing Doc
description: A document where AI agents write alongside you: coloured cursors with name tags glide between words, an agent types its suggestion letter by letter for you to accept or reject, and comments sit in the margin next to the lines they're about.

title: Code Review
description: A pull request review with a file tree, split or unified diffs with word-level highlights, inline threads you can reply to and resolve, Viewed checkboxes that fold files away, and an approve or request-changes panel.

title: Conductor
description: Chat with a lead agent while it works: it streams its replies, hands tasks to helpers whose progress ticks along in a side panel and writes what it learns straight into a launch brief you can edit beside the chat.

title: Confetti Burst
description: Confetti that blooms out of the button you pressed, hangs at the top of its arc in the air drag, flutters as each piece turns over and drifts down; reduced motion gets a quick check instead.

title: Connector Marketplace
description: A place to browse the apps that plug into your product: filter by category, search, and connect one through a short permissions step that shows the link being made.

title: Connectors
description: Browse every app your product plugs into, grouped by category in tidy two-up cards, with a sticky search, filters that glide, connect buttons that spin and settle into a quiet connected state, and a slide-over for permissions and settings.

title: Dashboard Header
description: The top of a dashboard: three trend cards, a this-period-versus-last chart you can scrub day by day, and a goal ring that fills as sales come in.

title: Delivery Tracker
description: Live order tracking on a hand-drawn city map: the courier rides the route as the ETA counts down, you can zoom in to follow them, message with quick replies, and rate and tip once it lands.

title: API Keys & Webhooks
description: Scoped API keys with a show-once secret, roll and revoke, plus webhook endpoints with event picking, a signing secret and a deliveries log where failed sends retry and flip to 200.

title: Docs Layout
description: A docs page shell: grouped sidebar, readable article with tabbed code and callouts, a reading-progress hairline and a right-hand outline whose marker glides to the section you're reading; the sidebar becomes a drawer on phones.

title: Docs Site
description: A documentation site with a top nav, collapsible sidebar, code samples whose language choice follows you across the page, a table of contents that tracks your scroll, ⌘K search over pages and headings, and prev and next cards.

title: Drip Loaders
description: Three loaders made of liquid in whatever colour you like: a comet of drops that stretches and gathers, a bead that drips into a pool, and a dot that splits and flows back together.

title: Drive
description: A cloud drive home with a sidebar of places and quick access, start-from-template cards, and folders that glide between a card grid and a tidy table when you switch views, with search, sort and stars.

title: Elastic List
description: A scrolling list with real rubber-band edges: drag or flick past either end and it stretches with growing resistance, then springs back, pulling down from the top winds up a spinner that snaps when it's ready to refresh, and the wheel hands off to the page once you reach an end.

title: FAQ
description: A searchable FAQ with topic tabs and live counts, matches marked in place, answers that open on a smooth measured height, and a copy-link button on every question that deep-links straight to it.

title: Feature Bento
description: A bento grid of feature tiles, each with a tiny working demo (search, shortcuts, version history, a flow, a chart) that wakes up on hover and rests when you leave.

title: First Project
description: The empty Projects page of an app: one line on what projects are for, a Create button with its shortcut, a guide link and three templates. Creating one flies the icon into the first row of a real project list.

title: First Run
description: A four-step setup for a brand-new AI workspace, with a springy stepper, tools that connect right where they sit, invites as chips, a live preview of your first agent and a calm summary you can jump back from.

title: Flags Console
description: A whole flag console in one piece: search and filter your flags, pick one to edit its targeting rules and rollout per environment, and watch a live log of requests getting their variant, with a marker the moment your change takes effect.

title: Flip Clock
description: A split-flap countdown where each changed digit's top flap falls away under gravity, darkening as it turns, and the new lower flap lands with one small rebound.

title: Folder View
description: One folder opened inside a drive, with a folder tree in the sidebar, type filters with counts, a grid of file cards with little drawn previews or a dense table, a bulk bar that rises with a rolling count when you pick a few, and ghost files fanning out of an empty sub-folder.

title: Forgot Password
description: Ask for a reset link, then a confirmation with the address it went to, a resend countdown and a way back to sign in.

title: Habits
description: A habit tracker that makes ticking things off feel good: checks fill and draw in a beat, counted habits fill like a glass, streaks roll up, and a week grid lets you patch the days you forgot to log.

title: Hairline Shell
description: An app frame drawn edge to edge on single hairlines, with header and footer rules running straight across, a marker that slides along the edge to the current page and a dense issue list you can walk with J and K.

title: Help Centre
description: A support site with a search that suggests articles as you type, topic cards, readable articles with a table of contents that follows you, and a feedback form that asks what went wrong.

title: Highlighter
description: A marker pen that sweeps behind your words one line after another, with a chisel tip, slightly ragged edges and ink that pools where each stroke starts and stops; runs when it scrolls into view or when its row is hovered.

title: Inbox Preview
description: A mail client in one block: unread dots, coloured labels, hover actions, rows you swipe to archive or mark read (with undo), j/k/e shortcuts and a reading pane that slides over the list on phones.

title: Ink Stamp
description: A rubber stamp that rises, winds up and slams onto the page with a quick squash and a jolt through the card, lifting away to leave a rough, slightly bled ink impression that comes out a little different every time.

title: Inset Shell
description: The frame an app lives in: a sidebar with workspace switcher, nav, colour-dotted projects and an account menu that folds down to an icon rail, beside a rounded inset page with live breadcrumbs and a floating drawer on phones.

title: Intake Survey
description: A one-question-at-a-time onboarding survey: answer with A–D, a quick blink confirms your pick before the next question glides in, multi-select with a limit, an optional free-text step and an editable summary at the end.

title: Issue Tracker
description: An issue list you drive with your hands on the keys: J and K to move, S, P, A and L to change status, priority, assignee and labels, X to multi-select, ⌘K for everything else, and rows glide to their new group when they change.

title: Kanban Board
description: A team board you can really work in: drag cards between columns, add one with a keystroke, filter by label, and open any card for its checklist and notes.

title: Lava Lamp
description: Warm wax blobs that wander, melt into one another and drift apart behind your content, with one that lazily trails your cursor.

title: Lift to Open
description: A thumbnail that lifts off the grid and grows into its own detail view as one object, cover and title travelling with it, the details fading in once it lands; Escape or a click outside folds it back into its exact slot.

title: Like Burst
description: A heart that squeezes and pops full with a thin ring and a flick of sparks, while the count rolls over digit by digit like an odometer; unliking fades back quietly.

title: Liquid Cursor
description: Inside its card the pointer becomes a drop of liquid with a short trail; hover a link or button and the drop pours itself into that shape, then pinches free when you move on.

title: Liquid FAB
description: A round action button that squeezes out its actions as droplets: each one stretches away, pinches off into its own button and gets drawn back in when you close it, with labels as tooltips and full keyboard support.

title: Magnetic
description: Buttons and icons lean toward your pointer as it comes near, labels drifting a little further than their buttons, then spring back the moment you move away.

title: Mail
description: A three-pane mail client you can run from the keyboard: J and K walk the threads, E archives with an undo, R drops you into a quick reply, and the reading pane slides over the list on phones.

title: Margin Notes
description: A reviewer's pen that draws itself onto your text as it scrolls into view: wobbly circles, double underlines, boxes and strike-throughs, then arrows that curve from a handwritten note to the words it means.

title: Marquee Text
description: An oversized headline that scrolls forever in alternating solid and outlined words, gliding to a halt when you hover instead of freezing mid-word.

title: Mega Footer
description: A full site footer: link columns with little badges, a one-field digest signup, a live status pill, language and theme switches, a legal row, and an oversized wordmark fading into the floor.

title: Money
description: A personal finance home: the balance rolls digit by digit as you switch accounts or pay a bill, the payment lands in your transactions, spending donut and budgets at once, and each budget shows if you’re spending ahead of pace.

title: Morph Icons
description: Menu to close, play to pause, plus to check, sun to moon: each pair is one set of paths in two poses, so lines rotate and stretch into place on a spring and reverse cleanly mid-way.

title: Music Player
description: A music app with gradient cover art that glows into the room, a waveform you can scrub, a drag-to-reorder queue and lyrics that follow the song line by line.

title: Newsletter CTA
description: An email capture that checks as you go, catches gmial-style typos, shakes once on a bad address, then morphs into a success note while your avatar joins the stack and the reader count rolls up by one.

title: Not Found
description: A 404 with a compass that dithers between headings until you move your mouse or start searching, plus a did-you-mean fix for the typo, inline search and popular links.

title: Notes
description: A notes app with folders, pinned notes that glide to the top, search that highlights matches as you type, and an editor where typing “[] ”, “- ” or “# ” turns a line into a checklist, bullet or heading.

title: Notification Matrix
description: Events down the side, email, push and in-app across the top: group checkboxes that go half-checked, locked security rows with a reason, edited cells that glow, and a save bar that floats in only when something changed.

title: Notification Settings
description: Channels you can open and tune, per-event email, push and chat toggles grouped under section switches, quiet hours on a small 24-hour track, and a digest line whose item count rolls as you change things.

title: Odometer
description: Digits that turn like a real counter: every place rolls the way the number moved, so 9 ticks over to 0 instead of spinning back, and it counts up the first time you scroll to it.

title: Pour Hero
description: A hero whose headline drips in as lime liquid: drops pinch off the top edge, splash on landing and set into real, selectable type, with a droplet button that squashes and splashes when pressed.

title: Pour Progress
description: Progress you can watch fill up: a stream pours in from the top, the surface sloshes and settles as the level eases to the value, and hitting 100% sends out a small ripple. Comes as a round vessel or a slim bar.

title: Press Ripple
description: A quiet wave that spreads from exactly where you pressed, clipped to the element's corners, finishes filling even on a quick tap, and gives Enter and Space the same feedback from the centre.

title: Pricing Table
description: Three plans side by side with a monthly or yearly toggle that rolls each price into place, and a full feature table that folds out underneath.

title: Profile
description: A social profile with a painted cover, a Follow button that pinches off a notification bell like a droplet, followers that roll up, and posts, replies and a media grid that opens into a lightbox.

title: Profile Settings
description: Edit your profile: crop a generated photo in a small dialog, claim a username with a live availability check and suggestions, see your local time on a tiny clock, and save from a bar that springs up when something changes.

title: Prompt Test Bench
description: Check a prompt before it ships, with pass rate by version against the bar it has to clear, a unified or side-by-side diff of what changed, and test cases that re-run live from queued to a rolling score.

title: Quote Wall
description: Customer quotes stacked in columns that drift past in opposite directions and settle the moment you stop to read one.

title: Request Access
description: The page you hit when a doc is private: who you are signed in as, a switch-account menu, an optional note and a Request access button. It then shows who the request went to, when, and a resend that unlocks after a countdown.

title: Revenue Story
description: A store's revenue told as a story: one big annotated line you can scrub day by day against last period, a plain-sentence summary whose numbers roll, a range switch that morphs the line and moves its notes, and a ranked strip of where the money came from.

title: Rim Light
description: A point of light that laps a card's border at a steady pace with a fading tail, tracing rounded corners exactly; every beam on the page shares one clock, so busy cards pulse in step.

title: Run Replay
description: Watch an agent work a task from start to finish: plan steps tick off, tool calls stream into a log, it stops to ask before sending anything, and the draft it's writing fills in beside it.

title: Sales Overview
description: A year of sales on one page: pick a number up top and the monthly chart, best sellers and channel split all follow it, with a line or bar view to taste.

title: Scramble Text
description: Text that decodes from random glyphs into the real words, sweeping left to right on view, on hover or on demand, with a monospace variant for codes and labels.

title: Security Settings
description: Password, two-factor, passkeys and sessions in grouped rows: a tiny ring counts recommended steps, passkeys are added inline while your device confirms, and signed-out sessions slide off the table one after another.

title: Settings & Plans
description: Workspace, members, API keys and billing in one calm settings screen: grouped rows, an unsaved-changes bar that springs up, invites and role changes, keys shown once, and usage bars that fill when you open Billing.

title: Sign In
description: A minimal centred sign-in: passkey and single sign-on side by side, email and password with a show toggle, a gentle shake when the password is wrong and a check when you’re in.

title: Sign-in Card
description: Email and password sign-in with a peek toggle, a one-tap switch to magic links, passkey and SSO buttons, a gentle shake on errors and a calm check-your-inbox state.

title: Sign Up
description: A minimal centred sign-up: name, work email and a password whose length hint ticks green as you type, with inline errors and the terms in one quiet line.

title: Skeleton Sweep
description: Loading placeholders lit by one sweep of light that crosses the whole card at once, with a matching glint for “Drafting…” status lines.

title: Something Went Wrong
description: An app error page with a small 1-bit dithered ?! glyph, Try again that fails once with a shake and then recovers into a check, a copyable error details panel and a quiet Report this link.

title: Split Shell
description: A frame for working with an agent: tasks on the left, its thread in the middle, and a work panel you can drag or nudge with arrow keys to watch its tool calls tick by, the page it's reading and the sources it will cite.

title: Split Sign-up
description: A two-panel sign-up: the form validates as you go (live email check, password rules that tick off, a strength bar) beside a product glimpse and rotating customer quotes that fold below on phones.

title: Spotlight Text
description: Dimmed copy with a soft warm spotlight that trails your pointer, bringing the words underneath to full contrast and uncovering a line that isn't there otherwise; on touch, or once you leave, the light drifts on a slow path of its own.

title: Stats Band
description: A band of big figures that count up once when it scrolls into view, sitting on a hairline ruler that draws itself in, with labels and captions on a steady divider rhythm.

title: Status Console
description: An ops console where an incident plays out live: services with ticking p95 sparklines, a timeline that moves from investigating to resolved, the fix rolling out in recent deploys, and an on-call card you can page from the keyboard.

title: Status Page
description: A public status page: a banner that names what's wrong, 90 days of uptime bars you can scrub with mouse or arrow keys, an incident timeline, and an inline subscribe form.

title: Tally Hero
description: A hero led by one giant figure that rolls up digit by digit as the itemised statement beneath it prints line by line, landing on a total that matches, with a period switch that re-tallies both.

title: Team Chat
description: Channels and DMs with grouped messages, reactions that roll their counts, and threads that open in a side panel; send something and a teammate starts typing back.

title: Team Grid
description: Team cards with tinted initials portraits, roles and a ticking local clock; hover, focus or tap one and a short bio with links slides over, plus a team filter and a we're-hiring card.

title: Members & Roles
description: Invite people, manage members and pending invites, and tune a role-by-permission matrix with a locked owner column, live head counts and a duplicate-to-customise role.

title: Ticket Tear
description: A booking ticket that, once confirmed, rips along its perforation: the stub pulls open from the top, comes free and drops away with a lazy spin, and the ticket you keep slides back to centre with its torn edge intact.

title: Torch Grid
description: One soft light follows your pointer across a grid of cards, washing over the one you're on and catching the rims of its neighbours across the gaps.

title: Two-step Setup
description: Turn on authenticator-app 2FA in three calm steps: scan a coded QR or copy the setup key, type the six digits, then copy or download backup codes before you can finish.

title: Typewriter
description: Types a phrase with a human rhythm, holds it long enough to read, then backspaces or selects it away and moves on; the caret only blinks while it waits.

title: Verify Email
description: The 6-digit code step: a centred code field split 3 + 3, a shake when the code is wrong, a resend timer that counts down and a mail icon that turns into a check.

title: Versus Table
description: An us-versus-the-old-way comparison with one raised, highlighted column, ticks that pop in as you scroll, a header that sticks, and a phone layout that compares against one rival at a time.

title: Video Call
description: A video call where the grid reflows as people drop in and out, whoever is talking gets a soft ring and a pulse, reactions float up the stage, and chat and people slide in beside it.

title: Waitlist
description: A join-the-line card: your position rolls down digit by digit, a referral link to copy, and friends who sign up drop into slots while you jump toward the next wave.

title: Wordmark Ticker
description: A quiet strip of customer wordmarks that eases to a stop under your cursor, flings when you drag it, and pauses with a click.
